jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**


GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non\-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well\-being potential.


Through our unique integrated payer\-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non\-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well\-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025\. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.


At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**


The Director, People Operations \& Solutions reports to the Executive Vice President, Head of People \& Culture as part of GreenShield’s (GS) People \& Culture (P\&C) department. This role will be accountable to design, develop, deploy, and operate the technology and analytics capabilities and roadmap for the tools and data needed to support our strategy, operating model, structure, processes, and people.  

This role will be focused on establishing business solutions that support and drive ongoing operational efficiency for our people and in service of our overall workforce. This role also establishes the digital foundation for outstanding service standards and pre\-determines intake and access routes tailored to specific client groups.  

This role will enable enhanced service delivery for our people processes to improve the employee and leader experience through enhanced insights and direct access to information and knowledge sharing.  

This role will play a critical leadership role in for our people.

* Technology \& Analytics Enabler: Technical and analytics solutions to enable better outcomes.
* People Operations: Lead operational delivery across payroll, case management, service intake/routing, knowledge management, controls, issue resolution, and service quality, ensuring reliable experiences for employees, leaders, and People \& Culture stakeholders.

* Technology Strategy: Develop \& implement.
* Technology Operations: Solution design, implementation, ongoing maintenance, solution support.
* Metrics: OKRs \& Operational KPIs.
* Data: Data governance, quality, data models and controls across employee data.
* Reporting: Design and quality assurance.
* Analytics: Supporting proactive decision\-making for P\&C operations, GreenShield organization design, and the overall people strategy and its workforce planning.
* Change Management: Ongoing processes \& systems engagement \& support.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

  

* Leadership: Strong leadership skills, self\-driven and resourceful
* Process Design \& Improvements: Problem\-solving experience with the ability to analyze processes and provide innovative solutions in a collaborative, agile way from process design to implementation. Experience with people and/or human resources processes and operations is an asset but not required.

This includes providing direction as a subject matter expert capable of conceptualizing, designing, delivering, and managing ongoing support for technology solutions. Experience with people and/or human resources technology solutions is an asset but not required.
* Data, Reporting \& Analysis: Demonstrated experience leading enterprise data, reporting and analytics capabilities, including data governance, data quality, reporting strategy, workforce insights and analytics. Experience working with People/HR data and translating workforce data into actionable business insights is required.

Lead the strategy, performance and overall health of Markel Canada's Professional \& Financial Risks portfolio, including Errors \& Omissions, Directors \& Officers, Cyber, Technology and other specialist financial and professional lines. The role is accountable for profitable growth, portfolio mix and capital efficiency; underwriting appetite, standards and governance; pricing and portfolio performance; coverage intent and product strategy; material referrals and exceptions; emerging\-risk and claims\-trend oversight; talent and technical capability; and senior market leadership. PFR comprises several distinct specialist businesses. The PLL must have strong financial and professional lines expertise and sufficient technical breadth to understand, challenge and lead across the portfolio. Deep expertise in one or more  

  

PFR areas is an asset, but identical specialist depth across every product is not required. The PLL remains accountable for underwriting standards, coverage intent, guidelines and product direction, while increasingly leading detailed development and execution through product specialists, underwriters and internal or external resources. The role works closely with Field teams and functional partners to build technical and leadership depth and ensure decisions are made at the appropriate level.**What part will you play?**
----------------------------

We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs. Join us and play your part in something special!

**The opportunity:**
--------------------


We are seeking a senior underwriting leader to lead the strategy, performance and health of our Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) portfolio in Canada. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of Markel Canada’s PFR portfolio, influence broader organizational strategy and strengthen our presence across specialty areas, customer segments and distribution channels. PFR brings together several distinct specialist businesses, including across our E\&O, D\&O and Cyber product lines. This role leads them collectively as one portfolio, while recognizing that each requires its own technical expertise, market knowledge and underwriting strategy. You will be accountable for sustainable profitable growth, portfolio mix, underwriting direction and the technical capability of the PFR business. As a senior leader, you will collaborate with other product line leaders, Field distribution teams, and other functional teams across global operations. Working closely with the Markel Canada leadership team, you will join a values\-driven culture with integrity and accountability at its core, with significant onward career opportunities.


If you are an underwriting leader who builds strong businesses and technical capability, brings sound judgment to a complex portfolio, and excels at creating value and market impact, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

  



This is an opportunity to join a growing and ambitious business in a high\-impact and visible role at a pivotal time in our journey. You will lead the development and delivery of Markel’s Professional \& Financial Risks (PFR) strategy in Canada, building greater growth, cohesion and performance across the PFR portfolio.


As part of the Product Leadership team, reporting into the SVP Underwriting, you are the senior leader responsible for the PFR underwriting strategy at Markel Canada. The role works closely with Field underwriting teams and with Claims, Actuarial, Data and Analytics, Operations and Distribution, as well as the International OCUO (Office of the Chief Underwriting Officer) and other UK\-based colleagues and, occasionally, US\-based colleagues, connecting Canadian opportunities with Markel’s broader international capabilities.

* Champion the technical capability of PFR, working with Field leaders and people managers on development, coaching and succession for PFR talent, and supporting specialists and senior underwriters to take ownership so that technical decisions are made at the appropriate level.
* Set the direction for underwriting guidelines, sector\-specific underwriting frameworks, product and coverage development, underwriting authorities and training priorities, with detailed development led by the appropriate product and sector specialists, underwriters and Field teams.

-----------------------

This role leads retail health and safety initiatives, monitors legal regulations, and develops strategies to address health and safety risks, protect associates and customers, and support safe operations.  

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

The Director, Specialty Compliance and Ethics develops and implements health and safety strategies to ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations across Walmart Canada’s retail stores. This may include designing and maintaining national health and safety programs, conducting risk assessments, and partnering with Retail Operations and other stakeholders to identify and mitigate risks. The role involves staying abreast of industry trends and regulatory changes to adapt health and safety strategies accordingly.

  

The Director builds and leads a team responsible for monitoring health and safety performance and managing key risk areas, including injury prevention, ergonomics, equipment, and fire and life safety. This includes developing training programs and awareness campaigns to foster a culture of health and safety throughout the organization. The position also ensures that health and safety activities are aligned with global standards and best practices.

  

In addition to internal responsibilities, the Director cultivates external relationships with regulators and industry partners to strengthen the company’s health and safety reputation. This involves articulating corporate positions on health and safety matters, responding to regulatory inquiries and enforcement matters, and leading regulatory outreach meetings.

  

Overall, the Director focuses on continuous improvement of health and safety processes and integrating safety metrics into core business practices. This includes evaluating program effectiveness, using data and AI tools with high degree of competency and appropriate human oversight, ensuring resource alignment with company strategy, and leveraging global talent and resources to achieve business goals.

* Experience supporting business growth, new locations, major operational change or transformation.

**Position: Director, Enterprise Risk \& Insurance**

**Location: Toronto, ON or Kansas City, MO**

**Employment: Full\-time, Director level**

**Reports to: Chief Financial Officer**

**Function: Corporate Finance**

**The Opportunity**


Black \& McDonald is a decentralized organization with significant operations across Canada and the United States. We are seeking an experienced risk and insurance leader to **oversee our enterprise\-wide property and casualty insurance program**, support our captive insurance entities, coordinate claims and loss\-management activities, and **lead our Enterprise Risk Management program**. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Director, Enterprise Risk \& Insurance will work closely with regional and corporate leaders to strengthen risk management while respecting the accountability and entrepreneurial approach of our operating businesses. **This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can combine technical insurance knowledge, financial analysis and practical business judgment.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Insurance and Risk Financing**

* Lead and coordinate the annual insurance renewal process across Canada and the United States.
* Evaluate insurance structures, limits, deductibles, retentions, exclusions, pricing and emerging coverage requirements.
* Analyze insurer proposals, loss trends, collateral requirements and alternative risk\-financing structures, and make recommendations to senior management.
* Oversee policy administration, endorsements, certificates of insurance, premium allocation and insurance documentation.
* Conduct periodic reviews of coverage gaps and emerging exposures, including cyber, professional liability, pollution, crime and project\-specific risks.

**Captive Insurance Oversight**

* Support the strategy, governance and financial oversight of the Company's captive insurance entities.
* Review captive financial results, reserves, loss development, liquidity, capital requirements and regulatory obligations.
* valuate retention levels, reinsurance structures, new coverage opportunities and alternative uses of captive capital.

**Claims and Loss Management**

* Lead regular reviews of loss runs and significant or developing claims.
* Challenge claim strategy, case reserves and expected outcomes where appropriate.
* Monitor loss frequency, severity and reserve development and translate findings into practical loss\-prevention and risk\-financing actions.

**Enterprise Risk Management**

* Lead the annual enterprise risk assessment process across operating regions and corporate functions.
* Maintain the enterprise risk framework, risk taxonomy, assessment tools, reporting and annual ERM calendar.
* Facilitate executive interviews, regional risk workshops and senior\-management risk discussions.

**Fraud Risk, Analytics and External Partners**

* Coordinate or support reviews of significant fraud or control incidents, including root\-cause analysis and remediation tracking.

**What You Bring**

* At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in insurance, risk management, finance, audit or a related discipline.
* Meaningful experience managing complex commercial property and casualty insurance programs and annual renewals.
* Experience working directly with insurance brokers, insurers and underwriters.
* Familiarity with claims management, loss runs, actuarial reserving, collateral requirements and loss development.
* Experience leading enterprise risk assessments and presenting risk matters to senior executives.
* Strong financial literacy and the ability to evaluate insurance and alternative risk\-financing structures.
* An undergraduate degree in business, finance, accounting, risk management or a related field.
* A relevant insurance, accounting or risk designation is considered an asset.
* Experience in a decentralized, multi\-location organization is preferred. Construction, engineering, infrastructure or another project\-based industry would be an asset.

**The Leadership Profile**


The successful candidate will be a credible and pragmatic leader who can influence without relying on formal authority. You will build trusted relationships with regional executives, Controllers and operational leaders while constructively challenging assumptions when risks require further attention.


You will bring structure and discipline to complex processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. Just as importantly, you will be willing to perform substantive analysis, translate technical concepts into clear business recommendations and exercise sound judgment about when matters require senior\-management attention.


This is an opportunity to shape and strengthen the risk and insurance function within a large, complex North American organization while working directly with senior leadership and operating businesses.


Please be advised that a Criminal Background Check and Professional Reference Check will be required as part of our employment screening and selection process. Additionally, all applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada, unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

execution, and creates durable growth.

opportunity management.

execution, the successful candidate may have opportunities to contribute to Bulloch’s


longer\-term U.S. growth agenda.

technology priorities with Bulloch capabilities, investments, and measurable


business outcomes.

senior IT, technology, operations, and business stakeholders and understand their


roadmaps, integration requirements, risks, and priorities.

account health assessments, stakeholder maps, opportunity pipelines, and clear


accountability for customer commitments.

relationships through additional deployments, software, services, and evolving


customer requirements.

currently using Bulloch, recognizing the strategic and long\-term nature of these


opportunities.

independent retailers.

development.

dynamics, and technology trends into actionable insights for product and business


leadership.

quarterly planning, and transparent reporting of opportunities and risks.

* A repeatable account management framework is operating across Canada and

actively used by the team.


* Strategic customers have clear account plans, governance cadences, stakeholder

maps, and documented growth priorities.


* Bulloch strengthens retention and share of wallet while building credible long\-term

pipelines with targeted new customers.

customer engagement.
